# StudioCue

> StudioCue (also written Studio Cue) is software for photography studios that runs every wedding and event from the first inquiry to the final gallery. It drafts each next step — the reply, the proposal, the agreement, the run of show, the crew offer — for the studio to approve, and gives the couple and the crew their own app in the studio's name. Website: https://studio-cue.com

StudioCue is for wedding photographers first, and also family and portrait sessions, corporate events and sports. Couples use a portal on any phone (nothing to download); second shooters and assistants get a crew app with offers, call times and day sheets. Cue, the assistant inside StudioCue, prepares work and never records a payment, a signature or a permission on its own. Invoices and payments go through the studio's own QuickBooks; StudioCue never takes a cut of client payments. Agreements are written from the accepted proposal and signed online in StudioCue. Pricing: Studio $150/month, Multi-Brand $299/month; 14-day trial, card required, nothing charged for 14 days.
